description: Progress of one user in one interface tour or task list. The tour engine reads it to resume the tour and to show only new steps after a tour version change. Users change it only through the tour API.

fields.description: User who owns this progress. The record is deleted with the user.
fields.label: User

fields.description: Stable identifier of the tour, defined by the user interface. Example: leave-application.
fields.label: Tour ID

fields.description: Version of the tour content the user last saw. A newer version shows only the steps the user has not seen.
fields.label: Tour Version

fields.description: Active: the tour is open or opens again. Snoozed: it opens again on the next visit. Skipped: closed for this version. Completed: finished for this version.
fields.label: Status

fields.description: Step identifier to resume the tour from. Empty when there is none.
fields.label: Current Step

fields.description: JSON list of step identifiers the user has seen, in first-seen order.
fields.label: Seen Steps

name: PLT Tour Progress
